description: Should launch 3 parallel agents with distinct perspectives
expected_behavior: Launches 3 parallel review agents (Recruiter, ATS, Level-Signal)
Each agent produces distinct, non-overlapping feedback
Synthesis combines all three into unified output
Output includes: verdict, top themes, prioritized actions, scorecard

precondition: Profile has field=nursing, resume contains nursing experience
description: Review should adapt to healthcare field
expected_behavior: Recruiter lens adapts to healthcare hiring norms
ATS keywords are nursing-specific (patient outcomes, certifications, protocols)
Level signals use nursing career ladder (RN, charge nurse, nurse manager)
No engineering or tech jargon in feedback

description: No resume on file — should offer ingestion
expected_behavior: Offers to ingest resume now (PDF or paste)
Does NOT crash or produce empty review

description: Feedback tone should match user's preference
expected_behavior: Tone is encouraging — leads with strengths before improvements
Still honest and specific about weaknesses
Does not sugarcoat to the point of being unhelpful
